messages:
sophie: publish job red on sdk-core after typegen bumped to 4.0.0. regen diffs in generated clients show default values removed for optional fields, causing snapshot churn and failing sample-app tests.

liam: can you paste the diff snippet? semver bump was major — was this intentional?

sophie: excerpt:
```
- timeout: 30
- retry: { attempts: 3 }
+ retry: undefined
``` 
This removal of defaults breaks shallow comparisons in our tests.

ci-bot: pipeline #6222 failed: regendiff-check (https://ci.redwood/pipelines/6222)

marco: if defaults were dropped that's a user-visible change. since version moved 3.x -> 4.0.0 it's major, but still surprising. recommend revert as a patch to restore compatibility and follow with a major that documents migration.

docs-bot: release automation requires a REGEN_NOTE.md in PR body when generated output changes. I don't see one on the typegen release PR.

ivy: short-term unblock: pin sdk-core to "typegen": "^3.9.0" in workspace to bypass regen; longer-term: add a CI pre-merge check that compares regen diffs and rejects PRs without REGEN_NOTE.md or a migration doc.

zack: I'll add a short devex onboarding blurb: "Before approving typegen bumps: run `yarn regen-check` locally, include REGEN_NOTE.md, and if output shape changes, add migration snippet to CHANGELOG.md." I'll open a PR to docs.

sophie: created PRs: typegen revert -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/1033, sdk-core pin -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-core/pull/210. kicking CI.

ci-bot: pipeline #6223 started (post-pin/revert)

ci-bot: pipeline #6223 passed — pin allowed bypass; regendiff-check skipped for pinned lockfile.

marco: follow-ups: add regen-check to local dev guide, update release template to mandate REGEN_NOTE.md for generator bumps, and add a golden test to sdk-core that asserts presence of defaults where expected.

sophie: assigning tasks in the release checklist and leaving this thread for traceability. :white_check_mark:
